# Mini

Fixture library for the checker tests. All skills: `ask-the-question`, `wedge-the-spec`, `shape-the-design`, `fire-the-build`, `sound-the-verify`, `open-the-release`, `keep-the-tend`.

| Phase | Skill | Fires when |
| :- | :- | :- |
| gather | `ask-the-question` | its trigger fires |
| spec | `wedge-the-spec` | its trigger fires |
| design | `shape-the-design` | its trigger fires |
| build | `fire-the-build` | its trigger fires |
| verify | `sound-the-verify` | its trigger fires |
| ship | `open-the-release` | its trigger fires |
| tend | `keep-the-tend` | its trigger fires |
